pages.text: A chest's color is its rarity: $(#777777)basic$(), $(#1b7a1b)fine$(), $(#1565c0)rare$(), $(#6a1b9a)epic$(), $(#b8860b)legendary$().$(br2)Searching takes time: items appear one by one, slower when they're valuable.
A chest may hold a $(l:loot/keys)key$() or a $(l:loot/relics)relic$().
